```python
from collections import Counter

words = "helvetica daffodil beaujolais sky wakeful wayside viet squabble didactic abash quiz".split()
submitted = "No"
errors = {}

def check(step, condition, detail):
    if not condition:
        errors.setdefault(step, []).append(detail)

def check_letters(step, index, claims):
    for word, letter, rank in claims:
        check(step, word in words, f"Unknown word: {word}")
        check(step, word[index] == letter,
              f"{word}: incorrect letter at position {index + 1}")
        check(step, ord(letter) - ord("a") + 1 == rank,
              f"{letter}: incorrect alphabet rank {rank}")

def check_state(step, groups):
    flat = [word for group in groups for word in group]
    check(step, Counter(flat) == Counter(words),
          "Missing, duplicated, or unexpected words")
    for earlier, later in zip(groups, groups[1:]):
        check(step, all(a < b for a in earlier for b in later),
              f"Incorrect ordering: {earlier} before {later}")

check_letters(1, 0, [
    ("helvetica", "h", 8), ("daffodil", "d", 4),
    ("beaujolais", "b", 2), ("sky", "s", 19),
    ("wakeful", "w", 23), ("wayside", "w", 23),
    ("viet", "v", 22), ("squabble", "s", 19),
    ("didactic", "d", 4), ("abash", "a", 1), ("quiz", "q", 17)
])

state2 = [
    ["abash"], ["beaujolais"], ["daffodil", "didactic"],
    ["helvetica"], ["quiz"], ["sky", "squabble"],
    ["viet"], ["wakeful", "wayside"]
]
check_state(2, state2)
for group, rank in zip(state2, [1, 2, 4, 8, 17, 19, 22, 23]):
    check(2, all(ord(w[0]) - ord("a") + 1 == rank for w in group),
          f"Incorrect initial-letter grouping: {group}")

check_letters(3, 1, [("daffodil", "a", 1), ("didactic", "i", 9)])
check(4, 1 < 9 and "daffodil" < "didactic", "Incorrect d-word comparison")
state4 = [
    ["abash"], ["beaujolais"], ["daffodil"], ["didactic"],
    ["helvetica"], ["quiz"], ["sky", "squabble"],
    ["viet"], ["wakeful", "wayside"]
]
check_state(4, state4)

check_letters(5, 1, [("sky", "k", 11), ("squabble", "q", 17)])
check(6, 11 < 17 and "sky" < "squabble", "Incorrect s-word comparison")
state6 = [
    ["abash"], ["beaujolais"], ["daffodil"], ["didactic"],
    ["helvetica"], ["quiz"], ["sky"], ["squabble"],
    ["viet"], ["wakeful", "wayside"]
]
check_state(6, state6)

check_letters(7, 1, [("wakeful", "a", 1), ("wayside", "a", 1)])
check(8, "wakeful"[1] == "wayside"[1] == "a",
      "Incorrect second-letter tie")
check_state(8, state6)

check_letters(9, 2, [("wakeful", "k", 11), ("wayside", "y", 25)])
check(10, 11 < 25 and "wakeful" < "wayside",
      "Incorrect w-word comparison")
final_words = "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky squabble viet wakeful wayside".split()
check_state(10, [[w] for w in final_words])
check(11, final_words == sorted(words),
      "Final answer does not equal the complete alphabetical ordering")

expected = str(min(errors)) if errors else "No"
print("Computed alphabetical order:", " ".join(sorted(words)))
print("First mistaken thought:", expected)
if errors:
    print("Reason:", "; ".join(errors[min(errors)]))
print("Submitted answer:", submitted)
print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
```
